<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 224.120 which corresponds to a protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 223.113 Da. The formula C₁₅H₁₃NO matches this mass within a few ppm (calculated neutral mass 223.0997 Da, [M+H]⁺ 224.1070 Da), making it the most plausible composition among simple CHON candidates.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H13NO</final_answer>
